viewMethod: Actual individual PNG viewed via tools.view_image; full actual submittedPrompt and selectedState read; current template, parent/role/API/guard chain inspected. Matching backup/plugins/library/login baseline PNGs and approved style PNG were directly viewed where applicable.
fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Push needs_reconciliation and clone running are independent complete job cards, both using current phase/status strings.

Idle push allows refresh and retry and omits cancel because jobPending=false. Running clone with busy=false allows refresh/cancel and omits retry because jobPending=true; no percentage/count/receipt input is invented.

styleFindings.finding: Readable white/light-gray local components, fine borders, restrained corners and blue action hierarchy match the shared style direction. Raster shading/texture and approximate scale must become flat CSS tokens; do not regenerate solely for those details.

limitations: Source-derived static design review only; no runtime API operation, authorization, clipboard, network, keyboard/focus, close/mask/Escape behavior or responsive viewport was executed.
Local-component specimens are independent; parent role/source bindings remain metadata. Existing baseline references establish host context, not runtime capture of these synthetic error/busy states.

Raster shading/texture, font/icon geometry and dimensions are approximate. Implement shared flat CSS tokens, responsive wrapping and existing scroll/focus/guard rules; this is not pixel-level CSS approval.
This per-image result neither completes the non-ToDoo platform unification task nor substitutes for the later global coverage/style/function review or authorizes product implementation.
